title: TSMC beats forecasts and guides higher
summary: The chipmaker said July to September earnings per ADR share were $4.60, above the $4.45 analysts expected, with sales of about $46.5 billion. Its filing also points to October to December sales of $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion. Even so, its shares and other chip stocks ended the day lower.
why: TSMC makes chips for many AI companies, so strong orders hint that its customers expect to sell a lot. Stocks can still fall on good news when investors hoped for even more.
source: TSMC Form 6-K (SEC) and FMP earnings data

title: Three of your companies report next week
summary: Market calendars list GE Aerospace for Oct. 20, Meta for Oct. 21 and Lockheed Martin for Oct. 22. Analysts expect earnings of about $2.00, $6.74 and $7.52 per share. Company dates can still change.
why: An earnings report is a company's report card for three months. If results beat or miss what analysts expected, the share price can jump or drop quickly.

title: A mixed day: Eli Lilly up, Rocket Lab down
summary: Eli Lilly gained 3.5% and Lockheed Martin 2.0%, while Rocket Lab lost 6.6%. The broad S&P 500 fund rose 0.3%. Stocks in different industries often move in different directions on the same day.
why: This is why owning a mix of companies can smooth the ride. When one part of the portfolio falls, another part may rise.
